name: Ca tai tuong chien xu
summary: Cá tai tượng chiên xù is on the Thới Sơn table. The Tiền Giang provincial portal cleans the fish, soaks it in salt water for about 15 minutes, and fries it in plenty of oil until it is evenly golden.
origin: Cù lao Thới Sơn. Vietnam Tourism sets it on the islet table. The Tiền Giang provincial portal, 5 Jan 2019, prints the fry.
texture: The provincial portal’s title is chiên xù. The method says the fish is fried until evenly golden, in plenty of oil, so it cooks through.
howToEat: The provincial portal says to clean the fish, take out the gills and the guts, soak the body in salt water for about 15 minutes so the slime eases, drain it, and fry it evenly in a pan with plenty of oil.
Roll it with herbs, rice paper, and bún. The dip on the provincial portal is mắm nêm, or nước mắm me.
A price was not printed. The price is Check on arrival. An hour was not printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Vietnam Tourism places the plate on cù lao Thới Sơn, about 6 km from Mỹ Tho. The provincial portal does not name a street. A shop is not a pick.
seoTitle: Ca tai tuong chien xu on Thoi Son
seoDescription: Fried elephant-ear fish on Thới Sơn. The Tiền Giang provincial portal soaks the fish and fries it evenly. The price is Check on arrival.
